description: The bar chart compares the self-report accuracy of GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini models before and after introspection training. The vertical axis represents the self-report accuracy, ranging from 0.00 to 1.00, with a linear scale. The horizontal axis lists two models: GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini. There are three sets of bars for each model, representing the control condition, before introspection training, and after introspection training. The control condition is shown in gray, before introspection training in light blue, and after introspection training in dark blue. For GPT-4o, the control condition has a self-report accuracy of approximately 0.25, which increases to about 0.50 after introspection training. For GPT-4o-mini, the control condition has a self-report accuracy of approximately 0.50, which increases to about 0.75 after introspection training. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and there are no bars that are visually emphasized.
